tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the user's LOCAL music library for tracks. Returns matches with their 'path' (the stable identity you pass to other tools). Use this to check what the user owns before playing.

query.description: Track title, artist, or album to search for.

tools.name: play_music
tools.description: Play tracks matching a query immediately, REPLACING the current queue. Resolves the query against the local library (handles artist/title/album). If a non-empty queue would be replaced, the user is asked to confirm first.

query.description: What to play (artist, title, or album).

path.description: Optional exact track path from search_library for a precise pick.

tools.name: enqueue_music
tools.description: Add tracks matching a query to the END of the queue without interrupting playback.

path.description: Optional exact track path from search_library.

tools.name: play_next
tools.description: Insert a track to play right AFTER the current one, without clearing the queue.

path.description: Optional exact track path from search_library.

tools.name: play_similar
tools.description: Curate more tracks acoustically similar to what is currently playing, using the DSP similarity walk. Use when the user wants 'more like this'.

tools.name: steer_mood
tools.description: Build a mood/vibe-based mix from the local library based on any mood descriptor (e.g. 'chill', 'energetic', 'melancholic', 'focus', 'workout', 'dark', 'upbeat', 'rainy day') and start playing it using DSP acoustic feature matching.

tools.name: search_by_acoustic_profile
tools.description: Search the local music library by acoustic properties extracted by DSP (energy 0.0-1.0, brightness 0.0-1.0, bpm range, genre filters). Use when the user asks for music with specific acoustic traits or energy levels.

tools.name: playback_control
tools.description: Control transport: pause, resume, skip, previous, stop, clear_queue, or shuffle.

tools.name: save_queue_as_playlist
tools.description: Save the current queue/walk (from the current position onward) as a named playlist.

tools.name: get_player_status
tools.description: Get the currently playing track, playback state, and queue length.

tools.name: get_current_track_info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata (title, artist, album, duration) about the current track.

tools.name: search_online
tools.description: Search Qobuz ONLINE for tracks/albums the user may not own locally. Returns results. Set download=true to fetch the top result — this ALWAYS asks the user to confirm first.

download.description: If true, offer to download the top match (requires user confirmation).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Look anything up on the web that the library can't answer: an artist's story, what a song is about, release dates, who produced or sampled what, band members, new or upcoming releases, tours, what genre or scene something belongs to, translations of titles. Returns a written answer (Google) or search snippets, each with its source. Answer from what it returns, briefly naming the source; never guess facts you could look up.

query.description: The question or search terms, with the artist name for context.

tools.name: learn_about
tools.description: Background on the CURRENT track, its artist or its album (or a named one): what the library knows (album, year, genre, country, plays) plus the web's story. Use for 'tell me about this song', 'who is this', 'what's this album'.

name.description: Optional: a named track/artist/album instead of what's playing.

tools.name: find_related_artists
tools.description: Artists the web calls similar to an artist (default: the one playing), split into those already in the user's library (playable now with play_music / enqueue_music) and the sources naming others (findable with search_online). Use for 'who else sounds like this', 'artists like X', 'build me a mix around X'.

artist.description: Artist name; omit for the current artist.

tools.name: get_library_overview
tools.description: Summary stats of the local library: total tracks, artist/album/playlist counts, and the top genres. Use for 'how big is my library' / 'what genres do I have'.

tools.name: get_top_played
tools.description: The user's most-played tracks with play counts. Use for 'my most played', 'favourite songs'.

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: List artists in the library (with per-artist track & album counts), optionally filtered. Use for 'how many artists', 'do I have <artist>', 'how many tracks by <artist>'.

tools.name: get_artist_albums
tools.description: List the albums the library holds for a given artist (title, year, genre, track count).

tools.name: get_album_tracks
tools.description: List the tracks on an album, in order. Artist is optional but disambiguates same-named albums.

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: List the user's saved playlists with their track counts.

tools.name: get_playlist_tracks
tools.description: List the tracks inside a named playlist, in order.

tools.name: get_recently_played
tools.description: The most recently played tracks, newest first. Use for 'what did I just play', 'what was I listening to'.

tools.name: get_track_details
tools.description: Rich metadata for one track (album, genre, year, duration, bpm, energy). Pass a query, or a path, or nothing to describe the current track. Use for 'what bpm is this', 'what year is this from'.

path.description: Exact track path from another tool.

tools.name: play_album
tools.description: Play a whole album in order, replacing the queue. Artist optional but disambiguates. Confirms first if a queue is already playing.

tools.name: play_playlist
tools.description: Play a named playlist in order, replacing the queue. Confirms first if a queue is already playing.

tools.name: get_metadata_status
tools.description: Metadata health: how many artists Auto-Play can place (have a genre or country), which artists have neither, and AI suggestions waiting for review. Use for 'which artists are missing info', 'is my metadata OK'.

tools.name: get_artist_metadata
tools.description: The stored genres and country of one library artist, where each came from, and any AI suggestion on file.

tools.name: research_artist_metadata
tools.description: Search the web (Google, with sources) for a library artist's genres and country. Saves the answer only as a SUGGESTION for review; changes nothing. Use when the user asks who an artist is, or to fill in a missing genre/country.

refresh.description: Search again even if an answer is cached.

tools.name: apply_artist_metadata
tools.description: Save genres and/or a country for one or MANY library artists in one call (this changes what Auto-Play does). By default the genres REPLACE what the artists had — use this to correct a wrong genre; mode='add' keeps existing tags. Omit genres and country to accept a single artist's pending AI suggestion. Always confirms with the user first.

artists.description: Several artist names to set at once.

genres.description: Lower-case genre tags. Prefer genres the library already uses.

mode.description: replace (default) or add to existing genres.
